notes.title: Post-Con Patch
notes.content:
We had loads of fun at SoCal Gaming Expo! We've released a small followup patch primarily to fix the problem where hints weren't showing up for the second half of Room 1. It also fixes various small visual bugs.

Occasionally during the weekend we encountered an unpredictable bug that crashes the game when you press a button. This has proved super difficult to reproduce, so we're having trouble determining if it's fixed or not. If you encounter this problem, please let us know!

notes.title: Quality-of-life update
notes.content: We've released a small update for the Surradia demo which introduces several quality-of-life features that players were asking for: A pause menu, additional navigation buttons, bigger and more clear page-turn buttons, hiding the Replay Audio button when sound is muted, and we've changed the word "vestibule" so you can all stop asking us what a vestibule is. We've also fixed the bug that was preventing hints from displaying in Room 3.
